headline.zh: OpenAI 將 GPT-5.6 整合至 Kiro 開發平台
headline.en: OpenAI Integrates GPT-5.6 into Kiro Platform

detail.zh: OpenAI 宣布將 GPT-5.6 引入 Kiro 軟體開發環境，協助工程師進行程式碼規劃、構建、審查與測試。該整合旨在提高軟體工程生命週期的性價比與自動化效率。
detail.en: OpenAI has launched GPT-5.6 in Kiro, aiming to streamline software development across planning, building, reviewing, and testing. The update brings improved price-performance to AI-assisted coding workflows.

headline.zh: OpenAI 針對 GPT-5.6 Sol 推出限時 API 降價優惠
headline.en: OpenAI Cuts API Pricing for GPT-5.6 Sol

detail.zh: OpenAI 更新 API 計價文件，針對 GPT-5.6 Sol 模型推出價格調降方案，優惠期至少持續至 11 月 21 日。此舉能直接降低構建高頻次模型呼叫應用的開發成本。
detail.en: OpenAI has updated its API pricing docs to reflect a price reduction for the GPT-5.6 Sol model through at least Nov 21. This provides direct cost savings for high-volume developer API workloads.

headline.zh: Hugging Face 傳出尋求 130 億美元估值收購談判
headline.en: Hugging Face Reportedly in $13B Acquisition Talks

detail.zh: 消息指出 Hugging Face 正與潛在買家接洽收購事宜，估值約 130 億美元。然而基於創辦團隊對開源社群的承諾，交易最終是否能達成仍存在變數。
detail.en: Hugging Face is reportedly fielding acquisition offers at a valuation around $13 billion. However, founder commitment to the open-source community casts doubt on whether a deal will ultimately go through.

headline.zh: llm-anthropic 0.27 發布：全面相容 Anthropic Python SDK v1.0
headline.en: llm-anthropic 0.27 Released with Anthropic Python SDK v1.0 Compatibility

detail.zh: Simon Willison 的 CLI 工具外掛 llm-anthropic 更新至 0.27，同步升級底層 Anthropic SDK 至 v1.0.0，並隨之將 HTTP 客戶端依賴項由 httpx 升級為 httpx2。
detail.en: Simon Willison's CLI plugin llm-anthropic has been updated to v0.27, bringing full compatibility with the new Anthropic Python SDK v1.0.0 and updating the HTTP client dependency to httpx2.

headline.zh: OCR It：自動提取無法複製文件純文字的 LLM 輔助工具
headline.en: OCR It: Extract Non-Copyable Text from Documents for LLMs

detail.zh: 開源專案 OCR It 旨在讓使用者迅速從不可複製或影像格式的檔案中提取文字，便利地餵給 LLM 進行後續分析與處理。
detail.en: OCR It is a lightweight tool designed to extract non-copyable text from images and documents, simplifying context pipeline preparation for LLMs.

headline.zh: Pure CMake 實現 GPT-2：僅用建置系統寫出語言模型推論

detail.zh: 開發者以純粹的 CMake 語言實作了 GPT-2 推論過程，展示了極端環境下的建置腳本與演算法能力，極具 Geek 實驗價值。
detail.en: A developer implemented GPT-2 inference entirely in pure CMake, showcasing creative algorithmic execution using build system configuration scripts.

headline.zh: 低延遲 AI 夥伴：實作陪同玩家遊玩《上古卷軸 V》
headline.en: Low-Latency AI Gaming Companion for Skyrim

detail.zh: 開發者打造了一款高即時性的 AI Companion 專案，結合語音識別與 LLM 推論，能在玩家遊玩《上古卷軸 V：無界天際》時即時進行對話與陪伴互動。
detail.en: A developer built a real-time AI companion that integrates low-latency voice pipeline and LLMs to interact with players live while playing Skyrim.

headline.zh: Instinct 全能 AI 助手引發隱私與資安合規隱憂
headline.en: Instinct AI Assistant Raises Privacy and Security Concerns

detail.zh: Instinct AI 助手憑藉強大的跨軟體操作權限贏得早期使用者讚譽，但其寬鬆的服務條款與高權限自動化操作能力，也讓安全專家對資料隱私風險提出警告。
detail.en: While early testers praise Instinct AI assistant's capabilities, security experts warn that its broad permissions and autonomous action capabilities pose serious privacy tradeoffs.

headline.zh: 史丹佛研究：AI 衝擊初階職缺最巨，受影響領域青年就業下滑 19%
headline.en: Stanford Study: AI Hits Entry-Level Jobs Hardest, Youth Employment Down 19%

detail.zh: 史丹佛最新研究顯示，在受 AI 技術影響最深遠的職業類別中，初階與年輕勞工的就業率相較於高抗性領域下滑了 19%，顯現生成式 AI 對職場新人結構的重構效應。
detail.en: A Stanford study reveals that young worker employment in AI-exposed fields fell 19% compared to AI-resistant occupations, showing significant structural impact on junior roles.

headline.zh: 專文反思：過度依賴 AI 輔助開發恐導致工程師專業能力斷層
headline.en: Essay Warns AI Reliance May Cause Collapse of Coding Expertise

detail.zh: 技術文章探討程式設計師長期倚賴 AI 自動補全與生成的後果，警告初學者可能因缺乏基礎功鍛鍊，致使整個產業的深層除錯與系統架構專業逐漸退化。
detail.en: An analysis argues that heavy dependence on AI coding assistants will hamper foundational learning for junior developers, ultimately eroding deep debugging and architectural expertise industry-wide.

headline.zh: 具身智能新星 General Intuition 獲新一輪融資，估值達 60 億美元
headline.en: General Intuition Reaches $6B Valuation for Physical AI Models

detail.zh: 致力於開發時空感知通用 Agent 模型的 General Intuition 正進行新一輪融資，估值達 60 億美元，投資方包含 Valor 與 Point72，重點加速機器人領域模型研發。
detail.en: Robotics foundation model startup General Intuition is raising at a $6 billion valuation from investors including Valor and Point72 to advance temporal-spatial agent capabilities.

headline.zh: OpenAI 密集佈局全場景 AI Agent，試圖推進大眾市場應用
headline.en: OpenAI Pushes to Build AI Agents for Mass Market Adoption

detail.zh: OpenAI 內部正積極將 AI Agent 的應用範疇從軟體工程擴展至一般消費與企業場景，期望透過自主代理工具改變用戶與技術互動的型態。
detail.en: OpenAI is aggressively expanding its AI agent roadmap beyond software engineering into general consumer and enterprise workflows to drive widespread adoption.

headline.zh: 將 Linux 可執行檔偽裝成 SQLite 資料庫檔的黑科技實作
headline.en: Linux Pattern Encapsulates Executable Binaries inside SQLite Databases

headline.zh: Mac 軟體開發商 CorkMac 聲明旗下產品堅決不採用任何 AI 技術
headline.en: CorkMac Declares Strict No-AI Stance Across All Software Products

headline.zh: Nvidia 高層捲入美超微走私 AI 伺服器至中國案件遭起訴
headline.en: Senior Nvidia Manager Indicted in Supermicro AI Server Smuggling Scheme

headline.zh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 將於 TechCrunch Disrupt 發表 AI 程式設計演講
headline.en: Replit CEO Amjad Masad to Discuss Future of AI Coding at TC Disrupt 2026
